'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Hey, soldier. You know... I think I'm done with these jobs from the Masters. The PMCs have teamed up with the local bosses and started putting the squeeze on them. And they're not just trying to shut them down... They want to take over! Getting caught in the middle of that is way too risky. So this is my last job for them. After this, I'm done. This time they want us to thin out the PMCs across the whole region. Thirty kills should satisfy them. Use machine guns, 9x39 weapons, SVD, TKPD, AKS-74U series, or AKM series, so everyone who needs to gets the message. They also want proof this time. Bring me ten PMC dogtags, any faction, and I'll make sure they end up where they're supposed to.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 30 PMC operatives with the specified weapons on [[Lighthouse]], [[Shoreline]], [[Reserve]], [[Ground Zero]] or [[The Lab]]
* Hand over 10 BEAR or USEC [[Dogtags]]
* Locate and neutralize any 5 [[Bosses]]

==Rewards==
* +28,000 [[EXP]]
* 5x [[9x39mm SP-6 gs ammo pack (20 pcs)]]
* 1x [[SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle]]
* 1× [[Secure container Epsilon]]
* Unlocks purchase of [[SR-3M 9x39 compact assault rifle]] at [[Prapor]] LL4
{{quote|The money's tempting, but these jobs... They're getting getting out of hand. Ah, whatever. Here's your cut.}}
